versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Freelancer Proposal Engine.
- Instantly generates client proposals, project quotes, freelance contracts, scopes of work, invoices, cold pitch emails, LinkedIn messages, rate increase letters, and other business documents for freelancers.
- Includes proven proposal structures, cold email templates, scope of work sections, invoice requirements, and rate increase letter formulas.
- Provides workflows for writing proposals, pitching clients, and raising rates with minimal information required.
- Contains up-to-date freelancer rate benchmarks by specialty for 2026.
